issues.title: Checkout country select: hydration mismatch because the other-countries list is sorted with a locale collator over Intl.DisplayNames, whose order differs between Node and the browser
issues.verification: Two mismatches, both from Intl differing between Node and the browser (different ICU/CLDR releases). (1) Order: [...REST].sort(localeCompare over Intl.DisplayNames) collates Arabic differently on each side, so option n named different countries. (2) Text: Node names PS 'الأراضي الفلسطينية', current Chromium 'فلسطين' (en: 'Palestinian Territories' vs 'Palestine'), so after fixing the order React still logged a text mismatch on option value=PS. Fix: during SSR and hydration the select renders ISO codes in ISO-code order (deterministic everywhere); after hydration (useSyncExternalStore server snapshot false) the browser's Intl.DisplayNames and collation take over. Verified 2026-10-05 in next dev --webpack on :3012 against the mock API: fresh tab, /ar/checkout and /en/checkout, console shows only HMR connected; server HTML has 13+54 options labelled by code; client DOM has 54 collated names (ar: أذربيجان, إسبانيا, أستراليا, …; en: Afghanistan, Albania, Argentina, …). pnpm typecheck (15/15, DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE placeholder for prisma generate, no DB), pnpm lint and prettier pass.
